Method of Attack: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in Wordpress plugins to inject JavaScript that loads scripts from admarketlocation.com and gotosecond2.com into the site's theme
Injected scripts redirect visitors to scam sites with unwanted browser notification subscriptions, fake surveys, giveaways, and fake Adobe Flash downloads
Creation of fake plugin directories containing further malware uploaded via abuse of /wp-admin/includes/plugin-install.php to upload and unzip fake plugins into /wp-content/plugins/
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerable Wordpress plugins (e.g., CP Contact Form with PayPal, Simple Fields)
Injection of malicious JavaScript into Wordpress themes
Uploading fake plugin directories via Wordpress admin features
Indicators of Compromise: Injected JavaScript loading scripts from admarketlocation.com and gotosecond2.com
